a1-hobbies-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Afternoons at Home
a1-hobbies-01.scenario: You are at the language exchange in Hanoi. Meg asks what you do in the afternoon. You usually read at home.
a1-hobbies-01.prompt: Tell Meg that you read at home in the afternoon.
a1-hobbies-01.target: Leo en casa por la tarde.
a1-hobbies-01.english: I read at home in the afternoon.
a1-hobbies-01.canDo: I can talk about familiar free-time activities.

a1-hobbies-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Fridays in the Park
a1-hobbies-02.scenario: Carlos asks what you do on Friday afternoons. You walk in the park and then study Spanish.
a1-hobbies-02.prompt: Tell Carlos two things you do on Fridays.
a1-hobbies-02.target: Camino en el parque y estudio español.
a1-hobbies-02.english: I walk in the park and I study Spanish.
a1-hobbies-02.canDo: I can name common hobbies and activities.

a1-hobbies-03.title: Communicative Challenge: My Weekly Routine
a1-hobbies-03.scenario: You are in the park in Hanoi with Daniela, who asks about your free-time routine. On Saturdays you play football and every week you listen to music.
a1-hobbies-03.prompt: Tell Daniela what you do on Saturdays and what you do every week.
cues: Say what you do on Saturdays
Say what you do every week
a1-hobbies-03.target: Los sábados juego al fútbol y cada semana escucho música.
a1-hobbies-03.english: On Saturdays I play football and every week I listen to music.
a1-hobbies-03.canDo: I can describe my habitual free-time routines.

a1-hobbies-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Getting to Know Meg
a1-hobbies-04.scenario: You meet Meg at the language exchange in Hanoi and want to know her better. You are curious about her free time and about music.
a1-hobbies-04.prompt: Ask Meg what she does in her free time and whether she likes music.
cues: Ask what she does in her free time
a1-hobbies-04.target: ¿Qué haces en tu tiempo libre? ¿Te gusta la música?
a1-hobbies-04.english: What do you do in your free time? Do you like music?
a1-hobbies-04.canDo: I can ask simple questions about hobbies.

a1-hobbies-05.title: Communicative Challenge: My Week
a1-hobbies-05.scenario: Carlos asks you about your week. You read at home on Monday, go out with your friends on Friday and rest on Sunday.
a1-hobbies-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what you do on Monday, Friday and Sunday.
cues: Say what you do on Monday
Say your plan with friends on Friday
Say what you do on Sunday
a1-hobbies-05.target: El lunes leo en casa, el viernes salgo con mis amigos y el domingo descanso.
a1-hobbies-05.english: On Monday I read at home, on Friday I go out with my friends and on Sunday I rest.
a1-hobbies-05.canDo: I can describe a simple week of hobbies and free-time activities.

a1-hobbies-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Weekends in the Park
a1-hobbies-consolidation.scenario: You are in the park in Hanoi and Daniela asks what you like doing at weekends. You like reading, and on Sundays you rest.
a1-hobbies-consolidation.prompt: Tell Daniela what you like doing at weekends and what you do on Sundays.
cues: Say what you like doing at weekends
Say what you do on Sundays
a1-hobbies-consolidation.target: Los fines de semana me gusta leer y los domingos descanso.
a1-hobbies-consolidation.english: On weekends I like to read and on Sundays I rest.
a1-hobbies-consolidation.canDo: I can use hobby vocabulary, present tense, questions, and time expressions.
